purpose: Prevent one-off UNCLASSIFIED anomalies from creating permanent qualification strata while allowing recurrent, sufficiently similar anomalies to become a later-generation taxonomy candidate.
mechanism_placeholder: density support with fixed similarity and minimum unique support
fixed_scope: Constructed role-local anomaly trace only; finite density support indicates recurrence under the fixed fingerprint, not semantic truth or general cluster validity.
similarity_rule: Hamming distance <= 1 over the five predeclared fingerprint fields, same scope_family required.
support_rule: A novel-stratum candidate requires at least 3 unique terminal UNCLASSIFIED anomaly identities within the fixed similarity neighborhood, with observations spanning at least 2 taxonomy generations. Duplicate IDs, transport failures, nonterminal observations, scope-family mismatch, and stale old-authority completions do not count.

fixed_trace.event: U1 terminal UNCLASSIFIED, fingerprint F, generation 50
fixed_trace.expected: support=1; remain noise; no new stratum

fixed_trace.event: duplicate U1 with new transport identity

fixed_trace.expected: support=2 but only one generation; no new stratum
support=3 across generations 50/51; candidate novel stratum may be sealed for generation 52, but not active yet

fixed_trace.event: late old-authority completion similar to F
separately sealed taxonomy decision activates candidate in generation 52
fixed_trace.expected: stratum may become active; U1-U3 remain consumed history and cannot retroactively satisfy fresh generation-52 coverage

fixed_trace.control: bounded anomalies never reach 3 unique across >=2 generations
fixed_trace.expected: remain UNCLASSIFIED/noise with frontier_nonempty=true and zero new credit

guards.G1: fingerprint, similarity radius, minimum support 3, and cross-generation persistence requirement are frozen before source audit
guards.G2: one anomaly remains noise and cannot create durable taxonomy structure
guards.G3: duplicate identities do not increase support
guards.G4: out-of-neighborhood anomalies do not increase support
guards.G5: support must contain unique terminal UNCLASSIFIED evidence only
guards.G6: support must span at least two taxonomy generations
guards.G7: transport failure/nonterminal/stale completions add no support
guards.G8: reaching density support creates only a candidate; activation needs a separate sealed taxonomy decision for a later generation
guards.G9: support anomalies remain consumed history and cannot satisfy fresh coverage after activation
guards.G10: insufficient support remains unresolved/noise with nonempty frontier
guards.G11: terminal leaf artifact must be independently read back before any role-local credit
guards.G12: accepted route has zero residual richer/protected/manual execution, zero finite optional monthly/trial/paid quota dependency, and zero incremental monetary cost

acceptance: PASS only if G1-G12 hold after public-source mechanism binding; no post-source radius/support/rubric edits.
credit_rule: Precommit earns zero credit; at most one role-local credit after terminal readback.
frontier_if_terminal: Select another non-conflicting switching/recovery failure mode; preserve the limitation that fixed fingerprint/radius choices may merge distinct novel regimes or split one regime.
